title: HubSpot search calls hit 429 even though the app is far under its 10-second limit
symptoms: No X-HubSpot-RateLimit headers on search responses
Other CRM endpoints keep working during the same burst
cause: Search endpoints have their own limit of five requests per second per account, separate from the per-app burst limit. Search responses carry no rate limit headers, so header-driven throttles never see it coming.
fix: Throttle search calls to at most four per second per portal with a dedicated limiter, and retry 429 with backoff. Prefer batch read by id when you already know the records.
apply: const searchLimiter = new Bottleneck({ minTime: 250, maxConcurrent: 1 }); await searchLimiter.schedule(() => client.crm.contacts.searchApi.doSearch(body));
affected: HubSpot CRM search endpoints, all tiers and app types, as of 2026-10
